text: I'm Nikhil Chary Sriramoju, a final-year B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at Vaagdevi College of Engineering (2023-2027), based in Telangana, India.
I interned as a Machine Learning Engineer at Yuva Intern (NSDC) in Aug-Sep 2026 and as a Data Analytics Intern at Thiranex in Jul-Aug 2026.
My certifications: NASSCOM / Skill India Digital Hub (AI-Data Engineering and Cloud Infrastructure Analyst), IBM SkillsBuild (AI Fundamentals), Reliance Foundation (AI/ML Engineer Foundation).
My core skills are LLM applications, RAG, agentic AI with LangGraph, CNN vision, embeddings and vector databases, FastAPI, Next.js, Docker and cloud deployment.

Projects I've built include an AI gateway with semantic caching, a hybrid-search RAG pipeline, a LoRA fine-tuning pipeline, a lakehouse analytics platform (Spark, Delta Lake, dbt, Airflow), an AI trip planner PWA and a GST invoice copilot.
You can find my code at github.com/Nikhil-creat.
